Bengaluru
Prompt, data-driven digital marketing manager focused on campaign performance and acquisition. Notice period: 15 days.

Digital Marketing Manager, Cognizant — Apr 2025 - Present
Lead end-to-end paid search and organic initiatives for client portfolios, optimizing channel mix to improve quality traffic and conversions. Launched and managed Google Ads campaigns across search and display with ongoing A/B tests of ad copy and bidding strategies, reducing cost-per-acquisition by measurable percentages on pilot accounts. Implemented on-page and technical SEO fixes to improve crawlability and lift keyword rankings for priority pages. Managed content promotion and community engagement strategies across platforms to increase social-driven site visits. Instrumented event tracking and multi-channel attribution in Google Analytics to measure funnel drop-off and inform bid and creative adjustments. Collaborated with product and engineering teams using Agile ceremonies, tracked tasks in Jira, and coordinated versioned assets via Git.

Skills: SEO, Google Ads, Google Analytics, Social Media Marketing, Jira, Git, Agile

Education:
B.Sc Computer Science, St. Xavier's College
